Resolves #19491

The 13.2 notes now tell the repositories split instead of listing its moves. The chapter replaces #19487's seed with:
- the experience: a fresh clone receives 252 MiB, where GitHub measured the repository at 5.21 GiB in August;
- why one repository stopped working: size, onboarding and release lines;
- how it ran: DevIndex, the history rewrite, the Agent OS cut, and the Fleet Manager's 31 minutes, as a sidebar;
- a War Story, "Green runs, frozen corpus";
- what a consumer installs now;
- a map of the repository homes.

It ends by pointing at *What we build next* (#19494), as Grace asked, instead of restating it. No other section changes.

Evidence: L1 (a documentation chapter; every number was re-measured against its primary on 2026-10-09) → L1 required. No residual.

The script counts (117/83 → 38/0), 231.57 MiB post-rewrite mirror, 30m49s Institution commit interval, deleted producer stage, August 29 zero-failure alarm comments, September 8 schedule stop, and hourly corpus workflow check against their primaries.
